title: Turn conflicting export requests into testable requirements

criteria.description: Requirements preserve admin-only access, team isolation, CSV, UTC timestamps, omission of emails, and asynchronous job/download flow. No unsupported expansion is presented as confirmed.
Explicitly surfaces the unresolved 30/90-day conflict, undecided expiry/size and relevant failure questions. Distinguishes questions and assumptions from decisions instead of inventing resolution.
Acceptance conditions are observable and cover denied access/no cross-team data and large exports; handoff is traceable to the brief and honest about unvalidated decisions.
